Package neqsim.process.corrosion

Class NorsokM506Rev2

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.corrosion.NorsokM506Rev2
public final class NorsokM506Rev2 extends Object
Unmitigated CO2 corrosion rate of water-wet carbon steel using NORSOK M-506 Rev. 2 (June 2005), sections 5.2 and 8.1. Supply an in-situ pH and wall shear stress for the wetted surface.
Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim contributors

  • Method Details

    • fugacityBar

      public static double fugacityBar(double temperatureC, double totalPressureBara, double gasCO2MoleFraction)
      Evaluate the section 8.1 CO2 fugacity correlation (equations 4, 5, 7 and 8).
      Parameters:
      temperatureC - fluid temperature in degrees Celsius
      totalPressureBara - absolute total pressure in bar
      gasCO2MoleFraction - CO2 mole fraction in gas
      Returns:
      CO2 fugacity in bar; the rate correlation accepts 0.1 to 10 bar
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for non-finite or out-of-range inputs

    • rateMmPerYear

      public static double rateMmPerYear(double temperatureC, double co2FugacityBar, double inSituPH, double wallShearStressPa)
      Calculate the bare-steel rate from the section 5.2 correlation. Intermediate temperatures linearly interpolate the two surrounding rates at the supplied fugacity, shear stress and pH.
      Parameters:
      temperatureC - fluid temperature (5 to 150 degrees Celsius)
      co2FugacityBar - CO2 fugacity in gas (0.1 to 10 bar)
      inSituPH - water pH at operating conditions (3.5 to 6.5)
      wallShearStressPa - shear at the wetted wall (1 to 150 Pa)
      Returns:
      unmitigated corrosion rate in mm/year
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for non-finite or out-of-range inputs

    • knotRate

      private static double knotRate(int knot, double fugacity, double ph, double shearFactor)
      Evaluate the complete rate at one tabulated temperature.
      Parameters:
      knot - temperature index
      fugacity - CO2 fugacity in bar
      ph - in-situ water pH
      shearFactor - section 5.2 shear multiplier
      Returns:
      rate in mm/year

    • phFactor

      private static double phFactor(int knot, double ph)
      Evaluate the Rev. 2 Table 2 pH factor for a temperature knot. At a shared pH boundary use the higher-pH interval.
      Parameters:
      knot - temperature index in Table 1
      ph - in-situ water pH
      Returns:
      dimensionless pH factor

      Check an inclusive finite range from the operating-input tables.

      maximum - upper bound
